text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor a-s-s-e-m-b-l-e-d the f-o-r-g-e-d p-r-o-f-i-l-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t s and l-o-g-g-e-d the p-l-a-n-n-e-d t-r-u-s-t b-u-i-l-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l-s.
2) the actor s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d the e-m-a-i-l s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e s to i-m-i-t-a-t-e i-n-t-i-m-a-c-y and l-o-g-g-e-d the m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-v-e f-r-a-m-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y b-o-u-n-d-a-r-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the actor c-o-d-e-d the p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t f-l-o-w s and l-o-g-g-e-d the e-x-t-r-a-c-t-i-o-n m-e-t-h-o-d s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l s-a-f-e-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d the m-u-l-e r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t p-a-t-h s and l-o-g-g-e-d the f-u-n-d r-o-u-t-i-n-g m-a-p s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-a-w-f-u-l n-e-s-s l-a-w f-u-l n-e-s-s c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d the a-n-t-i-r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n s and l-o-g-g-e-d the i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n t-a-c-t-i-c s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-m-u-n-i-t-y s-a-f-e-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
